## 简体中文

### 新增

- 新增可按应用名称和消息正则表达式配置的桌面通知规则，按顺序匹配，并为未匹配消息提供固定兜底规则。
- 支持自由组合通知卡片、居中文字、大字提醒、屏幕边缘发光、倒计时、声音或朗读，以及重要消息列表；可设置共享默认样式、规则独立样式和冷却时间。
- 支持拖动调整提醒位置、调整文字提醒最大宽度和重要消息列表大小；重要消息按最新优先显示，带时间戳，并支持逐条关闭。
- 点击提醒时优先尝试打开原始通知对应的消息，原始操作不可用时转为打开来源应用；可按规则隐藏系统横幅，同时保留通知中心中的消息。
- 新增全屏自动隐藏任务栏及按应用配置的全屏完全隐藏、全屏或窗口模式禁用快捷键选项；将任务栏、系统托盘和全屏应用设置分为独立页面。

### 修复

- 修复 Chrome DevTools 等窗口仅因叠放在前就被错误提升 Alt+Tab 使用次序的问题；按真实焦点维护排序，默认跳过当前窗口，并忽略后台及过期焦点回调。
- 修复原生全屏 Space 和其他桌面中的窗口在 Alt+Tab 或任务栏预览中遗漏的问题，同时排除失效的窗口记录。
- 改进通知内容解析，避免不完整卡片、相邻通知和系统控件文字混入消息内容。
- 修复重要消息列表滚动、内容变化和布局调整后的悬停反馈与关闭按钮显示；改进长文字省略、完整内容查看和拖动缩放时的位置稳定性。

### 使用说明

- 通知捕获依赖辅助功能权限和可见的 macOS 系统通知横幅；专注模式等系统设置可能阻止捕获。提醒和重要消息仅保存在内存中，退出应用后清空。

## English

### Added

- Added ordered desktop notification rules matching application names and message regular expressions, with a fixed fallback for unmatched messages.
- Added combinable notification cards, center text, large text, screen-edge glow, countdowns, sound or speech, and an important-message list, with shared defaults, per-rule styling, and cooldowns.
- Added draggable alert positions, adjustable text-alert width limits and important-message list sizing, plus newest-first important messages with timestamps and individual dismiss controls.
- Clicking an alert first attempts to open the message through its original notification action and opens the source application when that action is unavailable; rules can hide system banners while retaining messages in Notification Center.
- Added automatic taskbar hiding in fullscreen and per-application options to hide it completely or disable shortcuts in fullscreen or windowed mode; separated Taskbar, System Tray, and Fullscreen & Apps settings into dedicated pages.

### Fixed

- Fixed Chrome DevTools and other windows incorrectly moving ahead in Alt-Tab merely because of stacking order; ordering now follows actual focus, the default target skips the current window, and background or stale focus callbacks are ignored.
- Fixed missing windows from native fullscreen Spaces and other desktops in Alt-Tab and taskbar previews while excluding inactive window records.
- Improved notification parsing to keep incomplete cards, neighboring notifications, and system control labels out of message content.
- Fixed important-message hover feedback and dismiss-button visibility after scrolling, content changes, and layout updates; improved long-text truncation, full-content viewing, and position stability during dragging and resizing.

### Usage notes

- Notification capture requires Accessibility permission and visible macOS notification banners; system settings such as Focus may prevent capture. Alerts and important messages are held only in memory and cleared when the app quits.
